title.raw: 卷一百三十六 志第八十九 樂十一 Volume 136 Treatises 89: Music 11

translations.literal: Music 11.
translations.idiomatic: Music 11

translations.literal: (Hymn Section 5)
translations.idiomatic: (Hymn Section 5)

sentences.zh: ○祀嶽鎮海瀆祀大火祀大辰大中祥符五嶽加帝號祭告八首迎神，《靜安》

translations.literal: ○ Sacrifices to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers; sacrifices to the Great Fire and the Great Stars; in the Dazhong xiangfu era, imperial titles were added to the Five Sacred Mountains—eight presentation hymns for welcoming the spirits, "Jing'an."
translations.idiomatic: ○ Sacrifices to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers; sacrifices to the Great Fire and the Great Stars; in the Dazhong xiangfu era, when imperial titles were added to the Five Sacred Mountains—eight presentation hymns for welcoming the spirits, to the tune "Jing'an."

translations.literal: Bells and stones are already sounding; sacrificial stands and vessels are set before.
translations.idiomatic: The bells and stone chimes have begun; the stands and vessels stand ready before the altar.

translations.literal: Cloud-banners fly aloft; divine radiance is solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud-banners billow on high, and the spirit-light is grave and still.

translations.literal: You should mount the whirlwind and come to the azure circle.
translations.idiomatic: Mount the rushing wind and come to the azure vault of heaven.

translations.literal: We say the elaborate rites are complete; enjoy this auspicious purification.
translations.idiomatic: We declare the full rites prepared—receive this blessed and purified offering.

sentences.zh: 冊入門，《正安》節彼喬嶽，神明之府。

translations.literal: As the register enters the gate, "Zheng'an": regulated is that lofty peak, the abode of spirits and gods.
translations.idiomatic: When the register is borne through the gate, to the tune "Zheng'an": how lofty that great peak—the dwelling of the spirits.

translations.literal: Orderly, orderly is the majesty of the rites; solemn, solemn is the spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: In ordered majesty the ritual proceeds; in solemn stillness stands the spirit hall.

translations.literal: The excellent title can be exalted; all things alike behold it.
translations.idiomatic: The noble title is duly raised on high, and all creation may look upon it.

translations.literal: The emperor's register ascends with the name; thereby to pacify the nine regions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's register rises with the new name, to bring peace to the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 酌獻東嶽，《嘉安》節彼岱宗，有嚴廟貌。

translations.literal: Libation offering to the Eastern Peak, "Jia'an": regulated is Mount Dai, with a stern temple countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Libation to the Eastern Peak, to the tune "Jia'an": how ordered is Mount Dai, with its solemn temple aspect.

translations.literal: Only the sovereign serves Heaven, relying on the spirits to establish teaching.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign alone serves Heaven, and through the spirits establishes the teaching of the realm.

translations.literal: The imperial canon is brilliant; fine offerings are broadly rich.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial ordinances shine forth; fine offerings spread in abundance.

translations.literal: The utmost spirit draws near in thought; extraordinary auspice is the response.
translations.idiomatic: The highest spirit draws near in acceptance; wondrous blessings are the proof.

sentences.zh: 南嶽作鎮炎夏，畜茲靈光。

translations.literal: The Southern Peak stands as guardian in blazing summer, storing this spirit radiance.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Peak stands as guardian in the heat of summer, hoarding this spirit-light.

translations.literal: It spreads to the myriad things; they are already abundant and already flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: It spreads its bounty to all things, making them rich and thriving.

translations.literal: Thereupon warm jade is carved; thereby to present the emblematic seal.
translations.idiomatic: Warm jade is carved and offered as the emblem of honor.

translations.literal: Manifest is the spirits' blessing; fortune flourishes, grain piles high.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits' favor shines clear; blessings abound and harvests overflow.

translations.literal: Western Peak.
translations.idiomatic: Western Peak

translations.literal: Gazing upon Mount Taihua, it is established in fragrance as guardian.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze upon great Mount Hua, set in splendor as the western guardian.

translations.literal: The canonical register is received; rank and majesty are thereby exalted.
translations.idiomatic: The canonical register is received, and its rank and dignity are raised on high.

translations.literal: The senior lord upholds the ritual; he sacrifices to the ancestral lord and presents sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister upholds the rites, offering to the spirit-lord with true devotion.

translations.literal: May blessing reach the myriad states; forever matched with Earth's yielding virtue.
translations.idiomatic: May blessing reach every realm, forever joined with Earth's gentle yielding.

sentences.zh: 北嶽仰止靈嶽，鎮於朔方。

translations.literal: Northern Peak—look up to the spirit peak; it guards the northern quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Peak—look up to that spirit mountain, guardian of the northern realm.

translations.literal: The excellent title is further exalted, surpassing the constant statutes.
translations.idiomatic: The noble title is raised still higher, transcending the ancient ordinances.

translations.literal: Reverently presenting fine music; thereby displaying excellent fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently offer fine music and spread forth its noble fragrance.

translations.literal: Forever drawing pure blessing; the nation's fortune flourishes and thrives.
translations.idiomatic: May pure blessing endure forever, and the dynasty flourish without end.

sentences.zh: 中嶽岩岩神嶽，作鎮中央。

translations.literal: Central Peak—lofty, lofty is the spirit peak; it stands as guardian at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Central Peak—towering spirit mountain, guardian at the heart of the realm.

translations.literal: Solemnly offering the emblematic register; the honored name is greatly manifest.
translations.idiomatic: We solemnly present the emblematic register; the honored name shines forth in glory.

translations.literal: Descend swiftly on the wind-chariot; bear the orchid goblet in offering.
translations.idiomatic: Descend on the rushing wind-chariot and receive the orchid cup we raise.

translations.literal: The radiant rite is fully harmonious; the precious mandate grows ever more flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The glorious rite is fully complete; the sacred mandate grows ever more bright.

sentences.zh: 送神，《靜安》祗薦鴻名，寅威明祀。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, "Jing'an": reverently presenting the great name, reverently displaying the bright sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune "Jing'an": we reverently offer the great name and perform the solemn, luminous rite.

translations.literal: There is the splendor of Chu in the ritual; the sacrifice is as if the spirit were present.
translations.idiomatic: The rite has Chu splendor; the offering is made as though the spirit were truly here.

translations.literal: The offerings and presentations are already finished; ritual deportment is fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are complete; every detail of ritual bearing is in place.

translations.literal: The spirits' scrutiny is greatly manifest; fortune and joy come together.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits' gaze shines clear; blessing and joy draw near.

sentences.zh: 天安殿冊封五嶽帝一首

translations.literal: One hymn for enfeoffing the Five Sacred Mountain emperors in the Hall of Heavenly Peace.
translations.idiomatic: One hymn for enfeoffing the Five Sacred Mountain emperors in the Hall of Heavenly Peace

sentences.zh: 冊出入，《正安》名嶽奠方，帝儀克舉。

translations.literal: As the register enters and exits, "Zheng'an": the famed peaks are established in their regions; the imperial rite can be fully performed.
translations.idiomatic: As the register is borne in and out, to the tune "Zheng'an": the famed peaks are set in their domains; the imperial rite is duly raised.

translations.literal: The auspicious day is truly good; the nine ranks of guests all assemble.
translations.idiomatic: On this chosen auspicious day, guests of every rank gather in procession.

translations.literal: Warm jade is carved with inscriptions; scarlet robes are properly composed.
translations.idiomatic: Warm jade is carved with the sacred text; scarlet robes are worn in proper stillness.

translations.literal: Rites are complete and music accomplished; deep is the spirits' blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Rites are complete and music fulfilled; rich is the blessing of the spirits.

sentences.zh: 熙寧望祭嶽鎮海瀆十七首

translations.literal: Seventeen hymns for the Xining distant sacrifice to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen hymns for the Xining distant sacrifice to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers

sentences.zh: 東望迎神，《凝安》盛德惟木，勾芒禦神。

translations.literal: Eastern prospect, welcoming the spirits, "Ning'an": abundant virtue belongs to Wood; Goumang is the spirit who presides.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern prospect, welcoming the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": supreme virtue is Wood's; Goumang is the spirit who rules.

translations.literal: Mount Yi, Mount Dai, the Huai and the sea—their merit lies with the people.
translations.idiomatic: From Mount Yi and Mount Dai to the Huai and the sea—their merit rests with the people.

translations.literal: Thereupon the altar is made radiant; all the many spirits are gathered to face.
translations.idiomatic: The altar glows with light; the host of spirits is gathered to receive our rite.

translations.literal: Thereby to enjoy acceptance; spirit blessings all arrive.
translations.idiomatic: May they delight in our offering; every spirit-gift draws near.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, "Tong'an."
translations.idiomatic: Ascending and descending, to the tune "Tong'an"

translations.literal: Sashes and skirts hang down; jade pendants cluster.
translations.idiomatic: Sashes and skirts hang low; jade pendants cluster at the belt.

translations.literal: As we are about to perform the rite, the spirits feast and rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: As we take up the rite, the spirits feast and rejoice.

translations.literal: The emperor commands the distant sacrifice; who would dare not offer in common?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor has ordained this distant sacrifice—who would dare withhold their share.

translations.literal: Going back and forth to their stations—solemn, solemn; harmonious, harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Moving to and from their stations—in solemn grace, in harmony.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》祀以崇德，幣則有儀。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, "Ming'an": sacrifice is to exalt virtue; the offerings have their proper form.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune "Ming'an": we sacrifice to exalt virtue; every offering follows its proper form.

translations.literal: Solemn is our conduct of the rite; ascending and descending are most timely.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly we perform the rite; every ascent and descent is perfectly timed.

translations.literal: Clear, bright, pure, and clean—nothing is not reverently offered.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and pure in every detail—nothing fails of reverent offering.

translations.literal: The scribe's words are without shame; the spirits therefore come.
translations.idiomatic: The scribe's record is without fault; the spirits therefore draw near.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《成安》肇茲東土，含潤無疆。

translations.literal: Libation offering, "Cheng'an": from the beginning this eastern land holds moisture without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, to the tune "Cheng'an": from the first this eastern land holds moisture without end.

translations.literal: It is the season when spring unfolds; gladly we present excellent fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Now spring unfolds; gladly we offer its finest fragrance.

translations.literal: In sacrifice mugwort and straw are used and sunk down; following their nature they hold and store.
translations.idiomatic: We sacrifice with mugwort and straw and sink them in offering, following their nature to hold and nurture.

translations.literal: Neither drying up nor barren, they bring down auspicious blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Never dry, never wasted—they bring down blessing and good fortune.

sentences.zh: 送神，《凝安》神之至止，熙壇為春。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, "Ning'an": when the spirits arrive and halt, the radiant altar becomes spring.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": when the spirits arrive, the bright altar turns to spring.

translations.literal: When the spirits are about to return, banners and robes flutter vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirits prepare to depart, banners and robes flutter in splendor.

translations.literal: The returning whirlwind; deep and far, the swirling clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The wind wheels back; far and deep, the clouds whirl away.

translations.literal: Bless the eastern quarter; forever extend your benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Bless the eastern realm; extend your kindness forever.

translations.literal: Southern prospect, welcoming the spirits, "Ning'an."
translations.idiomatic: Southern prospect, welcoming the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an"

translations.literal: Mount Song, Mount Ji, Mount Heng, Mount Huo—and likewise their seas and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Song, Mount Ji, Mount Heng, and Mount Huo—and with them their seas and rivers.

translations.literal: The season is for long nurturing; it favors our southern domain.
translations.idiomatic: This is the season of growth and nurture; it blesses our southern land.

translations.literal: We broadly set forth solemn victims and silks; the spirits thereby come down.
translations.idiomatic: We lay out solemn offerings and silks; the spirits descend to receive them.

translations.literal: To assist and to settle them—hundredfold blessings are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: To assist and to comfort them—blessings beyond count are heaped high.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《成安》景風應律，朱鳥開辰。

translations.literal: Libation offering, "Cheng'an": the warm wind answers to the pitch-pipes; the Vermilion Bird opens the season.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, to the tune "Cheng'an": the warm wind matches the pitch-pipes; the Vermilion Bird opens the season.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn is the bright sacrifice; fine platters are set forth in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and bright is the sacrifice; fine platters are laid out in rows.

translations.literal: Victims used are pure red beasts; music is performed in the Ruibin mode.
translations.idiomatic: Pure red victims are offered; music sounds in the Ruibin mode.

translations.literal: Able to bring lasting blessing; protect these people below.
translations.idiomatic: May lasting blessing be secured; protect the people below.

sentences.zh: 送神，《凝安》鼓鍾云云，龡管伊伊。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, "Ning'an": drums and bells resound on and on; flutes and pipes sound long and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": drums and bells roll on; flutes and pipes sing long and clear.

translations.literal: The spirits are already drunk and sated; we say, escort them—words of return.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are drunk and full; we bid them farewell and send them home.

translations.literal: Mountains have deep stores; waters have spirit virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains hold deep treasure; waters hold spirit virtue.

translations.literal: Things forever rely on them; go to settle the abode of flame.
translations.idiomatic: May all things rely on them forever; go to dwell in the realm of fire.

sentences.zh: 中望迎神，《凝安》維土作德，維帝御行。

translations.literal: Central prospect, welcoming the spirits, "Ning'an": only Earth produces virtue; only the Emperor conducts its movement.
translations.idiomatic: Central prospect, welcoming the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": Earth alone gives virtue; the Emperor alone guides its course.

translations.literal: Embracing and nurturing, bearing and rearing—the myriad things thereby come to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Embracing and nurturing, bearing and rearing—all things are brought to completion.

translations.literal: There is a solemn sacrificial canon; we present our fragrant virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Our solemn canon of sacrifice offers up the fragrance of our virtue.

translations.literal: May the spirits delight and rest; forever employ boundless peace.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits delight and abide; may endless peace endure.

translations.literal: Libation offering, "Cheng'an."
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, to the tune "Cheng'an"

translations.literal: Lofty and broad, fused and joined—truly this is the center.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty and vast, fused and joined—this is truly the center.

translations.literal: It diffuses qi and reports merit; it benefits that one region.
translations.idiomatic: It spreads its breath and reports its merit; it blesses this whole region.

translations.literal: At the pit altar we sacrifice; the six kinds of music ring and ring.
translations.idiomatic: At the pit altar we sacrifice; the six ensembles ring clear.

translations.literal: May the spirits have joy; libation is poured with the great jade scepter-cup.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits rejoice; we pour libation with the great jade cup.

sentences.zh: 送神，《凝安》言旋其處，以奠中域。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, "Ning'an": we say, turn back to your place; thereby settle the central domain.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": return to your dwelling; establish the central realm.

translations.literal: Do not replace this spirit; the four quarters take it as model.
translations.idiomatic: Let this spirit never fail; let the four quarters take it as their model.

translations.literal: The spirits never cease; the sacrifices never lapse.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits never rest; the sacrifices never fail.

translations.literal: To enjoy and to repay—for ten thousand such years.
translations.idiomatic: To receive and to repay—for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 西望迎神，《凝安》品物順說，時司金行。

translations.literal: Western prospect, welcoming the spirits, "Ning'an": all things follow and rejoice; the season is ruled by the Metal phase.
translations.idiomatic: Western prospect, welcoming the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an": all things follow in joy; the season belongs to Metal.

translations.literal: At the suburban altar we welcome the qi; thereby to gaze toward the many spirits.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban altar we welcome the season's breath and gaze toward the host of spirits.

translations.literal: Elegant songs are the music; jade and offerings are only the victims.
translations.idiomatic: Elegant songs are our music; jade and victims are our offering.

translations.literal: Making the people's blessing; forever assisting their completion.
translations.idiomatic: You make the people's blessing; forever aid their fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《成安》西顥沆碭，執矩司秋。

translations.literal: Libation offering, "Cheng'an": the western radiance is vast and bright; holding the square, it governs autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, to the tune "Cheng'an": the western sky is vast and bright; holding the square, it rules autumn.

translations.literal: Consulting words harmonize with the spirits; the seasonal sacrifice is greatly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Our words accord with the spirits; the seasonal sacrifice is fully perfected.

translations.literal: In the rites there are offerings and presentations; thereby we regard the lords and marquises.
translations.idiomatic: The rites require offerings and presentations; thus we honor lords and marquises.

translations.literal: In ordered ranks we sacrifice to them; hundredfold blessings are strong.
translations.idiomatic: In due order we sacrifice; every blessing draws near in force.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, "Ning'an."
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune "Ning'an"

translations.literal: We delight our spirits; stands and trays hold savory feasts.
translations.idiomatic: We delight our spirits with music; stands and trays brim with savory feast.

translations.literal: We say, the spirits return; the western land is their palace.
translations.idiomatic: We say the spirits return—the western realm is their dwelling.

translations.literal: There birds and fish multiply; there plants and trees spread.
translations.idiomatic: Birds and fish flourish there; plants and trees spread abroad.

translations.literal: Enrich our marshes and wetlands; nourish our high uplands.
translations.idiomatic: Enrich our marshes and lowlands; nourish our high plateaus.

sentences.zh: 北望迎神，《凝安》帝德乘坎，時禦閉藏，爰潔牷醴，兆茲北方。

translations.literal: Northern prospect, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》: the emperor's virtue rides the Kan phase; the season governs closing and storing; thereupon pure red victims and ale, an omen in this northern quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Northern prospect, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: imperial virtue rides Water's power; the season seals all away in store—we offer pure victims and ale, a sign for the northern realm.

translations.literal: Seas and mountains are their dwelling; the spirits' bounty is without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Seas and mountains are their home; the spirits' gifts know no limit.

translations.literal: Fully enjoying purification and auspice; blessings descend, abundantly heaped.
translations.idiomatic: They fully receive our pure offering; blessings descend in overflowing measure.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《成安》淒寒凝陰，隕籜滌場。

translations.literal: Libation offering, 《Cheng'an》: bleak cold congeals the yin; fallen husks cleanse the threshing ground.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: bleak cold fixes the shade; fallen husks sweep the threshing floor clean.

translations.literal: The hundred things follow and ripen; millet and panicled millet are fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: All things ripen in their season; millet and grain breathe fragrance.

translations.literal: We sincerely approach at the northern suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: We draw near in sincerity at the northern suburban altar.

translations.literal: Thereby following its quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we follow the rites of this direction.

translations.literal: How shall we assist the spirits?
translations.idiomatic: How shall we assist the spirits?

translations.literal: Present this fine libation.
translations.idiomatic: We offer this noble cup.

sentences.zh: 送神，《凝安》維山及川，奠宅幽方。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, 《Ning'an》: mountains and rivers alike—settle your dwelling in the dark quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: mountains and rivers—make your home in the hidden north.

translations.literal: We measure their spirit; descending and halting have no fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: We gauge their spirit's coming; their descent and rest follow no fixed rule.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn is the pit altar—already welcoming, already escorting.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn stands the pit altar—we welcome, we escort.

translations.literal: Hasten the music, withdraw the stands—thus we send them off, thus we gaze after.
translations.idiomatic: Music quickens, the stands are cleared—we send them forth and gaze after them.

sentences.zh: 紹興祀嶽鎮海瀆四十三首

translations.literal: Forty-three hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-three hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the mountains, prefectures, seas, and rivers

sentences.zh: 東方迎神，《凝安》帝奠九壥，孰匪我疆。

translations.literal: Eastern quarter, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》: the emperor establishes the nine regions—who is not within our domain?
translations.idiomatic: Eastern quarter, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: the emperor sets the nine domains—who lies outside our realm?

translations.literal: Ah, our eastern land—mountains and rivers gaze upon one another.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, our eastern land—mountain after mountain, river facing river.

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs are most timely; solemn harmony is not forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice is perfectly timed; solemn harmony is never forgotten.

translations.literal: Towering, vast and misty—abundant, how expansive!
translations.idiomatic: Towering, vast and mist-wreathed—how rich, how boundless!

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, 《Tong'an》.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, to the tune 《Tong'an》

translations.literal: The azure yang first opens; sacrificial affairs are greatly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Spring's azure breath first unfolds; every rite is set in order.

translations.literal: The perfumer assists in pouring; its fragrance is full and rich.
translations.idiomatic: The perfumer aids the pouring; fragrance rises rich and full.

translations.literal: Revere your majesty of bearing—it too is a great standard.
translations.idiomatic: Honor your ritual bearing—it too is a sacred rule.

translations.literal: When the spirits draw near in thought, may they never find me weary.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirits draw near, may they never find me wanting.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》司曆告時，惟孟之春。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Ming'an》: the calendar office announces the season—it is the first month of spring.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ming'an》: the calendar office proclaims the season—the first month of spring.

translations.literal: Thereupon the seasonal sacrifice is raised; we process before the spirits who have power.
translations.idiomatic: We raise the seasonal sacrifice and process before the spirits in their power.

translations.literal: Drums and bells are already set; jade scepters and silks are all displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Drums and bells stand ready; jade and silks are laid out in full.

translations.literal: Make abundant and multiply the myriad things, thereby to bless our people.
translations.idiomatic: Make all things flourish and multiply, and bless our people.

sentences.zh: 東嶽位酌獻，《成安》岩岩天齊，自古在昔。

translations.literal: Eastern Peak station, libation offering, 《Cheng'an》: lofty, lofty is Mount Tianqi; from ancient times, in days of old.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Peak station, libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: towering Mount Tianqi—so it has been since antiquity.

translations.literal: Clouds a foot wide spread; the four quarters receive their moisture.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds no wider than a handbreadth spread; the four quarters receive their rain.

translations.literal: Only at the season of eastern labors are sacrificial affairs then ordered.
translations.idiomatic: At the season when the east begins its work, the sacrifice is set in order.

translations.literal: Favor us without bound; grace touches moving things and plants.
translations.idiomatic: Favor us without end; your grace reaches every living thing and plant.

sentences.zh: 東鎮位惟山有鎮，雄於其方。

translations.literal: Eastern Prefecture station: only mountains can be guardians; each is mighty in its quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Prefecture station: mountains alone can be guardians, each mighty in its domain.

translations.literal: In the east, which is chief?
translations.idiomatic: In the east, which is chief?

translations.literal: It is in the domain of Mount Yi.
translations.idiomatic: It is Mount Yi in its domain.

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs have their season; thereupon the old statutes are raised.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice has its season; we raise the ancient ordinances once more.

translations.literal: Our gaze is not far; we may hope for a feast of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Our gaze is not distant; we may hope you will feast in peace.

translations.literal: Eastern Sea station.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sea station

translations.literal: Vast and boundless, primordial mist—the sky shares its infinity.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and primordial, without limit—the sky shares its endless reach.

translations.literal: It guides and receives the Yangtze and Han; it regulates and diffuses north and south.
translations.idiomatic: It guides the Yangtze and Han and balances north and south.

translations.literal: Following and aiding their work—being good at descending is virtue alone.
translations.idiomatic: It aids their work in turn; to settle low is its true virtue.

translations.literal: Our sacrifice is most timely; thereby to seek great blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Our sacrifice is perfectly timed, that great blessing may come.

translations.literal: Eastern River station: what is our sacrifice for?
translations.idiomatic: Eastern River station: what do we sacrifice for?

translations.literal: It is at that long Huai River.
translations.idiomatic: It is for the long Huai River.

translations.literal: Its source is guided from Tongbai; it pours and empties into Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: Its source rises at Tongbai and pours away toward the eastern sea.

translations.literal: It shields Qi and protects Chu; it displays might and shows forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: It shields Qi and guards Chu, showing power and gentle care.

translations.literal: Stands and platters are set forth in rows; they too are greatly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Stands and platters are laid in rows, all in perfect array.

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, libation presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, libation presentation

translations.literal: (The four positions use the same [hymn].)
translations.idiomatic: (The four positions use the same hymn.)

translations.literal: End of parenthetical note.
translations.idiomatic: End of parenthetical note.

translations.literal: Our sacrifice is most solemn; may the spirits peacefully remain.
translations.idiomatic: Our sacrifice is deeply solemn; may the spirits rest in peace.

translations.literal: At ease they wander and turn, as if stopping, as if floating.
translations.idiomatic: At ease they drift and turn, now still, now floating.

translations.literal: Harmonize with this double libation; extend it with a hundred delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Join this double cup and extend it with a hundred dishes.

translations.literal: Do not find me weary or remiss; the myriad states' blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Do not find me remiss—blessing for every realm.

sentences.zh: 送神，《凝安》蹇兮紛紛，神實戾止。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, 《Ning'an》: difficult, how bustling—the spirits truly arrive and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: how bustling their coming—the spirits truly arrive.

translations.literal: With drink and with food, with enjoyment and with sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: With drink and food, with feast and sacrifice.

translations.literal: Young and dim, dim in the dark—the spirits also return and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Far into the dark they go; the spirits too return home.

translations.literal: Drunk and sated, thereby bestowing your blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Drunk and full—we grant you blessing.

translations.literal: Southern quarter, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Southern quarter, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》

translations.literal: Vermilion brightness flourishes and grows; our sacrifice is thereby ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Summer's vermilion blaze grows full; our sacrifice is set in order.

translations.literal: What is this sacrifice for?
translations.idiomatic: What is this sacrifice for?

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers, all in their ranks.
translations.idiomatic: For mountains and rivers, each in due rank.

translations.literal: As if we were about to see them—careful, careful, uniformly reverent.
translations.idiomatic: As though we might see them—reverent, restrained, and still.

translations.literal: O spirits, how abundant! Leisurely you come and arrive!
translations.idiomatic: O spirits, how full your power! Leisurely you come to us!

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗、升降，《同安》爰熙嘉壇，揭虔毖祀。

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, 《Tong'an》: thereupon the fine altar is made radiant; we raise sincere and pure sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, to the tune 《Tong'an》: the sacred altar glows; we raise a pure and reverent rite.

translations.literal: The perfumer pours the washing; he assists our unadorned rite.
translations.idiomatic: The perfumer pours the cleansing water and aids our primary offering.

translations.literal: In descending and ascending, in acting and in stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Descending and ascending, moving and resting.

translations.literal: None are not solemn and harmonious; we announce to the spirits—they feast.
translations.idiomatic: All is solemn and harmonious; we tell the spirits—the feast is ready.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》我祀我享，儀物孔周。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Ming'an》: we sacrifice, we enjoy; ritual objects are greatly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ming'an》: we sacrifice and feast; every ritual object is in place.

translations.literal: One pure offering is raised; the two essences are then cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: One pure offering is raised; the two spirits are duly honored.

translations.literal: The uncarved jade, how warm; the silk, how lustrous.
translations.idiomatic: Uncarved jade, warm to the touch; silk, bright and fine.

translations.literal: These we present, pure and clean; O spirits, peacefully remain.
translations.idiomatic: We offer them pure and clean—O spirits, abide in peace.

sentences.zh: 南嶽位酌獻，《成安》神曰司天，居南之衡。

translations.literal: Southern Peak station, libation offering, 《Cheng'an》: the spirit is called He Who Governs Heaven, dwelling at the southern balance.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Peak station, libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: the spirit called Governor of Heaven dwells at the southern pole.

translations.literal: In that position one becomes emperor; thereby to establish the quarter.
translations.idiomatic: In that place one stands as sovereign; thereby the quarter is secured.

translations.literal: The southern quarter's ordered affairs; the distant-sacrifice rites have their constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: The southern rites proceed in order; the distant sacrifice keeps its constant form.

translations.literal: We may hope for fine peace; great blessing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: May there be fine peace; may boundless blessing come.

translations.literal: Southern Prefecture station.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Prefecture station

translations.literal: Only in the south is a mountain—there at Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the south stands a mountain—there at Kuaiji.

translations.literal: Established as guardian in antiquity; the spirit presides over it.
translations.idiomatic: Made guardian long ago, the spirit rules it still.

translations.literal: It has ancient statutes—for sacrifice, for season.
translations.idiomatic: It has ancient ordinances—for sacrifice at the proper season.

translations.literal: A hundred flavors are all fine; may the spirits feast upon them.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred flavors, all exquisite—may the spirits feast in joy.

sentences.zh: 南海位維水善下，利物曰功。

translations.literal: Southern Sea station: only water is good at descending; benefiting things is called merit.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Sea station: water alone knows how to settle low; to benefit all things is its merit.

translations.literal: Winding are the hundred streams—who will turn toward the ancestral lord?
translations.idiomatic: The hundred streams wind on—who will turn to pay homage?

translations.literal: Vast is the great receptacle; there all converge as one.
translations.idiomatic: Vast is the great receiving sea; there all waters meet as one.

translations.literal: Roasted fat and fragrant herbs are set forth in rows, to answer the primordial mist.
translations.idiomatic: Roasted offerings and fragrant herbs are laid in rows, answering the primordial void.

sentences.zh: 南瀆位四瀆之利，經營中國。

translations.literal: Southern River station: the benefit of the four rivers, managing the central states.
translations.idiomatic: Southern River station: the four rivers' bounty, sustaining the central realm.

translations.literal: The southern one is called the Great River—how perilous, Heaven's making!
translations.idiomatic: The southern river is the Great River—how perilous, a work of Heaven!

translations.literal: Only you have a spirit; yonder is your temple sustenance.
translations.idiomatic: You alone have a spirit; yonder your temple receives its offerings.

translations.literal: The distant sacrifice's ranks are most timely; my heart is cautious, cautious.
translations.idiomatic: The distant sacrifice is perfectly timed; my heart is full of care.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，酌獻神之遊兮，洋洋對越。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, libation presentation: the spirits wander—vast, vast, facing in response.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, libation presentation: the spirits wander—vast and bright, answering our rite.

translations.literal: Calm and at ease; subtle resonance is the response.
translations.idiomatic: Calm and unhurried; subtle resonance answers us.

translations.literal: The music is already complete; the eight sounds have their proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: The performance is ready; the eight tones keep perfect time.

translations.literal: The double libation is extended and set forth; the hundred rites are thereby harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: The double cup is offered again; the hundred rites are fully joined.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits

translations.literal: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)
translations.idiomatic: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)

translations.literal: Offerings withdrawn, stands and platters cleared—the radiant rite is fully accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings are withdrawn, stands and platters cleared—the glorious rite is complete.

translations.literal: O spirit, about to return; feather banners are numerous and swirling.
translations.idiomatic: O spirit, you are about to depart; feather banners swirl in profusion.

translations.literal: Drifting away it departs; floating in empty, thin clouds.
translations.idiomatic: You drift away and vanish, floating through empty wisps of cloud.

translations.literal: Sadly turning to look back, with a heart that cherishes and remembers.
translations.idiomatic: Sadly we turn to gaze after you, our hearts full of tender remembrance.

sentences.zh: 中央迎神，《凝安》天作高山，屹然中峙。

translations.literal: Central quarter, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》: Heaven made the high mountain, towering in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Central quarter, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: Heaven made the lofty peak, standing firm at the center.

translations.literal: Managing its domain, myriads all follow and succeed.
translations.idiomatic: It governs its realm, and countless beings all flourish in its care.

translations.literal: Fire flourishes, Earth is sovereign; thereupon the seasonal sacrifice is raised.
translations.idiomatic: Fire blazes bright and Earth holds sway; thus we hold the seasonal rite.

translations.literal: Careful, careful the announcement extends; as if coming to arrive and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently the summons goes forth; you seem almost to come and abide.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗、升降，《同安》思來感格，肅雍不忘。

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, 《Tong'an》: thinking of your coming, moved to attend; solemn and harmonious, never forgetting.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, to the tune 《Tong'an》: mindful of your coming, we are moved to receive you—solemn, harmonious, and never forgetful.

translations.literal: Rites and ceremonies are already complete; numerous and dignified.
translations.idiomatic: The rites are fully prepared; the officers move in stately array.

translations.literal: Pure cleansing to show reverence; going forth to present its fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Purified and cleansed, we show our reverence and go forth to offer fragrance.

translations.literal: Mutual as if there is reception; O spirits, greatly feast.
translations.idiomatic: We meet as though you receive us; O spirits, feast abundantly.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》練日有望，高靈來下。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Ming'an》: on the purified day we look up in hope; lofty spirits descend.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ming'an》: on this purified day we look up in hope, and lofty spirits descend.

translations.literal: How shall we declare our sincerity?
translations.idiomatic: How shall we declare our sincerity?

translations.literal: The heart alone relies on things as surrogates.
translations.idiomatic: The heart can only speak through these offerings as its stand-ins.

translations.literal: There are baskets with their contents.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets are filled with their offerings.

translations.literal: There are treasures on their mats.
translations.idiomatic: Treasures lie upon their mats.

translations.literal: With these we make offering; spirit light illuminates the night.
translations.idiomatic: With these we make our offering, and spirit-light shines through the night.

translations.literal: Central Peak station, libation offering, 《Cheng'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Central Peak station, libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》

translations.literal: Equal in height with Heaven's utmost reach—Mount Song is so high.
translations.idiomatic: Level with Heaven's summit—Mount Song rises so high.

translations.literal: Manifest spirits show wondrous effects; divine rest is greatly bright.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits show their power in wonders; divine blessing shines forth.

translations.literal: Order our sacrificial affairs; full stands and aromatic fat.
translations.idiomatic: We set our sacrifice in order; stands are heaped with fragrant roasted offerings.

translations.literal: To assist with fine wine; its fragrance has peppercorn.
translations.idiomatic: We assist with noble wine, fragrant with pepper and spice.

sentences.zh: 中鎮位禹畫九州，河內曰冀。

translations.literal: Central Prefecture station: Yu traced the Nine Provinces; within the River was called Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Central Prefecture station: Yu mapped the Nine Provinces, and the land within the Yellow River was called Ji.

translations.literal: Mount Huo, lofty and high, made guardian, accumulating power.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Huo towers on high, made a guardian peak, gathering its mighty force.

translations.literal: How shall our sacrifice be?
translations.idiomatic: What shall our sacrifice be?

translations.literal: A hundred blended finest flavors.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred blended flavors, all exquisite.

translations.literal: Receiving the spirits in peaceful feast; all spirits fully arrive.
translations.idiomatic: We receive the spirits in peaceful feast, and every spirit has come.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，酌獻禮樂既成，肅容有常。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, libation presentation: rites and music are complete; solemn bearing has its constant form.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, libation presentation: the rites and music are complete, and solemn bearing keeps its proper form.

translations.literal: Suddenly staying, leisurely wavering.
translations.idiomatic: For a moment you linger, drifting at ease.

translations.literal: Extend and complete the double libation.
translations.idiomatic: We extend and complete the double cup.

translations.literal: Looking up, declaring what we seek; blessings descend, vast and overflowing.
translations.idiomatic: We look up and declare our prayer; blessings descend in overflowing measure.

translations.literal: Taking the mountain as model, proclaiming the imperial ordinance.
translations.idiomatic: Following the mountain's example, we proclaim the imperial decree.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits

translations.literal: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)
translations.idiomatic: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)

translations.literal: From dawn's approach, the spirits also have joy.
translations.idiomatic: From earliest dawn, the spirits too rejoice.

translations.literal: With difficulty wanting to prance, the elephant carriage is already lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Eager to gallop forth, the spirit carriage is already raised.

translations.literal: Blessing sounds send off; the spirits straightway return.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing sounds send you forth; the spirits now return home.

translations.literal: Long without end; grant me blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May it last forever; grant us your blessing.

translations.literal: Western quarter, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Western quarter, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》

translations.literal: There is towering stability; there is embracing harmony.
translations.idiomatic: It stands lofty and secure; it embraces all in harmony.

translations.literal: Thereby aiding its completion; truly this sacrifice is the response.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we aid its fulfillment; this sacrifice is our true reply.

translations.literal: Thereupon ordering the performance; the performance is already harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: We set the music in order; the performance is already in harmony.

translations.literal: Brightly descending to halt; thus following, thus receiving.
translations.idiomatic: In radiant splendor you descend and abide; we follow and receive you.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗、升降，《同安》靡實不新，靡陳不濯。

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, 《Tong'an》: there is no offering not fresh, nothing set forth not washed.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, to the tune 《Tong'an》: no offering but what is fresh, nothing set out that is not cleansed.

translations.literal: If people are not pure, how much less dare one pour libation.
translations.idiomatic: If we ourselves are not pure, how dare we pour the libation?

translations.literal: Drying the towel; moistening the ladle.
translations.idiomatic: We dry the towel and moisten the ladle.

translations.literal: Washing rites declared complete; ascending and descending timely and proper.
translations.idiomatic: The washing rites are declared complete; ascent and descent proceed in proper time.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》彼林有庪，彼澤有沈。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Ming'an》: yonder forest has the spirit mound; yonder marsh has the deep offering.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ming'an》: in that forest stands the spirit mound; in that marsh lies the deep offering.

translations.literal: Ah, gazing westward; neither scant nor excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, as we gaze toward the west—neither sparing nor excessive.

translations.literal: Thereby reaching this dwelling; thereby extending this measure.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we reach this dwelling; thus we extend this domain.

translations.literal: The facing rite is completed; thereby this is enjoyed.
translations.idiomatic: The facing rite is complete; with this we offer our devotion.

sentences.zh: 西嶽位酌獻，《成安》屹削厥方，風雲斯所。

translations.literal: Western Peak station, libation offering, 《Cheng'an》: towering and steep is its quarter; winds and clouds belong here.
translations.idiomatic: Western Peak station, libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: steep and towering is its domain—the home of wind and cloud.

translations.literal: In the shady town there is a palace; spacious and grand.
translations.idiomatic: In the shadowed realm stands a palace, vast and majestic.

translations.literal: Clear ale is in the vessel; the spirit calmly below.
translations.idiomatic: Clear wine fills the cup; the spirit rests in calm below.

translations.literal: Presented upon the stand—none refuse us.
translations.idiomatic: Offered upon the stand—you do not refuse us.

translations.literal: Western Prefecture station.
translations.idiomatic: Western Prefecture station

translations.literal: Only Wu, lofty and high, west of the Mian.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Wu towers on high, west of the Mian River.

translations.literal: Gazing at yonder ridge, brilliantly never erring.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze upon that ridge, bright and never astray.

translations.literal: Able to aid the peak; I pour the first libation.
translations.idiomatic: You aid the sacred peak; I pour the first libation.

translations.literal: For all who journey, this foundation alone is where they ascend.
translations.idiomatic: For every traveler, this is the foundation where all ascend.

sentences.zh: 西海位奄浸坤軸，滋殖其濊。

translations.literal: Western Sea station: overspreading and soaking the earth-axis, nourishing and multiplying its bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sea station: it overspreads and soaks the earth's axis, enriching and multiplying its vast domain.

translations.literal: Its ancient canon is examined; there are steps and enclosing walls.
translations.idiomatic: Its ancient canon is consulted; steps and enclosing walls stand ready.

translations.literal: Never ceasing seasonal observance; the great jade cup is poured.
translations.idiomatic: Season after season it is never neglected; the great jade cup is poured in libation.

translations.literal: Why give precedence to the river?
translations.idiomatic: Why should the river come first?

translations.literal: Truly the place where waters meet and gather.
translations.idiomatic: It is truly the place where the waters converge.

sentences.zh: 西瀆位自彼昆虛，於以潛流。

translations.literal: Western River station: from yonder Kunlun heights, thereby flowing hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Western River station: from Kunlun's heights it flows hidden beneath the earth.

translations.literal: Reflecting on this abundant moisture, how can the marquis not follow suit.
translations.idiomatic: Considering this overflowing bounty, how can the lord not do likewise?

translations.literal: In ancient times the central prefecture, reaching the sea was then cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient days the central domain reached the sea, and the rites were duly maintained.

translations.literal: Having reached the full moon's rest, the spirit protector first receives the libation vessel.
translations.idiomatic: When the full moon has passed, the guardian spirit first receives the libation cup.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻肅肅其乂，既旨既溢。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings: solemn and orderly, already fine, already overflowing.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings: solemn and well ordered, already rich, already brimming full.

translations.literal: When the libation is complete, everywhere here is broad and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: When the pouring is complete, blessings spread wide and rich.

translations.literal: The sacrificial affair is accomplished; we dare not be careless or remiss.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice is complete; we dare not be careless or negligent.

translations.literal: The spirits perhaps drunk and resting; my heart is thereby pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits may be drunk and at rest; my heart is filled with joy.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits

translations.literal: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)
translations.idiomatic: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)

translations.literal: Offerings already withdrawn, performance already reaching the final stanza.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are already cleared away; the music has reached its final verse.

translations.literal: No leftovers on this stand; respectfully hear our petition.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing remains upon the stand; hear our reverent petition.

translations.literal: Neither halting nor stumbling, neither boiling over nor breaking.
translations.idiomatic: Neither faltering nor falling, neither boiling over nor bursting forth.

translations.literal: Drive away the drought demon; forever shelter the whole realm.
translations.idiomatic: Drive off the drought demon; forever shelter the entire realm.

sentences.zh: 北方迎神，《凝安》我土綿綿，孰匪疆理。

translations.literal: Northern quarter, welcoming the spirits, 《Ning'an》: our land is vast and unbroken; who is not within our domain's governance.
translations.idiomatic: Northern quarter, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Ning'an》: our land stretches on without end—who lies outside our realm's rule?

translations.literal: Only the season of the dark capital—not called remote and alone.
translations.idiomatic: This is the season of the dark capital—not some distant and isolated place.

translations.literal: Pure is the Gen month; the north wind joins with it!
translations.idiomatic: Pure is the northeast month; the north wind joins in!

translations.literal: What barrier, what depth—still they come down.
translations.idiomatic: What barrier, what distance—still you come down to us.

sentences.zh: 初獻盥洗、升降，《同安》壽宮煇煌，聿修時祀。

translations.literal: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, 《Tong'an》: the longevity palace is radiant; thereupon the seasonal sacrifice is maintained.
translations.idiomatic: First offering, hand-washing, ascending and descending, to the tune 《Tong'an》: the longevity palace shines bright; we duly perform the seasonal rite.

translations.literal: How abundant their coming; auspicious purification to await.
translations.idiomatic: How splendid their arrival; with blessed purification we wait.

translations.literal: In dwelling, lofty; in movement, orderly.
translations.idiomatic: In repose, upright and dignified; in movement, orderly and sure.

translations.literal: Revere what you oversee; display your offices and arrange the affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Revere your appointed duties; perform your offices and set each task in place.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《明安》相予陰威，厥功浩浩。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Ming'an》: aid me with yin power; its merit is vast.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ming'an》: aid us with your yin power; your merit is boundless.

translations.literal: A year's labor—how shall we repay it?
translations.idiomatic: A whole year's labor—how shall we repay it?

translations.literal: The treasury has jade scepters and silks; how dare I keep them for myself!
translations.idiomatic: The treasury holds jade and silks—how dare I keep them for myself!

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn, deeply mindful; with these we present them.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and deeply reverent, with these we offer them up.

translations.literal: Northern Peak station, libation offering, 《Cheng'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Peak station, libation offering, to the tune 《Cheng'an》

translations.literal: Gazing at that vast expanse, called the constant of the north.
translations.idiomatic: We gaze upon that boundless reach—the fixed order of the north.

translations.literal: Both lofty and deep; both norm and guiding principle.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty and deep alike—it is both measure and model.

translations.literal: Presenting fragrant ale at the beginning; the spirits show great strength.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant ale is offered at the start; the spirits show their mighty power.

translations.literal: Dark robes and iron chariot, surveying this realm below.
translations.idiomatic: In dark robes and iron chariot, you survey this world below.

sentences.zh: 北鎮位赫赫作鎮，幽、朔之垂。

translations.literal: Northern Prefecture station: brilliantly made guardian, the frontier of You and Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Prefecture station: gloriously made a guardian peak, on the borderland of You and Shuo.

translations.literal: Together blessing our people; how fitting the food.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing our people together—how fitting this feast.

translations.literal: Able to match that peak; there is solemn rank and ceremonial vesture.
translations.idiomatic: Able to match that lofty peak, with solemn dignity befitting its rank.

translations.literal: Purify my libation rites; how dare I not be reverent!
translations.idiomatic: Purify our pouring rites; how could we fail to be reverent!

sentences.zh: 北海位八裔皆水，此一會同。

translations.literal: Northern Sea station: the eight directions are all water; here all converge as one.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Sea station: all eight directions are water; here they meet as one.

translations.literal: Vast, vast is the sky's expanse; deeply stirring, primordial mist.
translations.idiomatic: Boundless is the vault of heaven, surging through the primordial void.

translations.literal: How great is Kan alone! Without this merit!
translations.idiomatic: Supreme is Kan alone—without this power, what would we have!

translations.literal: What order does it hold?
translations.idiomatic: What rank does it hold?

translations.literal: Yellow waters flow at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Golden waters flow at the center.

sentences.zh: 北瀆位水星之精，播液發靈。

translations.literal: Northern River station: essence of the Water Star, spreading moisture and manifesting spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Northern River station: the Water Star's essence, spreading its fluids and awakening the spirits.

translations.literal: Not constrained by the river, already distinct and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Not hemmed in by the river, already separate and pure.

translations.literal: With reverent care, washing and offering; peppered glutinous rice, fragrant and sweet.
translations.idiomatic: With solemn care we wash and offer; peppered glutinous rice, fragrant and sweet.

translations.literal: Now stopping, now lingering; there they lower the green banners.
translations.idiomatic: Now pausing, now lingering; there the green banners are lowered.

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerings

translations.literal: Sacrificial stands and vessels are arrayed in profusion; metal and stone instruments gather in rich harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Stands and vessels are spread in abundance; bells, stones, and instruments resound together.

translations.literal: Accompanied by a second libation cup; neither irreverent nor negligent.
translations.idiomatic: Accompanied by a second cup of wine, neither irreverent nor negligent.

translations.literal: My rites are complete; my heart is deeply reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Our rites are complete; our hearts are deeply on guard.

translations.literal: Calm and at ease, as if they were truly present.
translations.idiomatic: Calm and unhurried, as if they were still here.

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits

translations.literal: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)
translations.idiomatic: (The melody is the same as for welcoming the spirits.)

translations.literal: The spirits are already sated with wine; the rite is now withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are drunk and full; the rite is now withdrawn.

translations.literal: The spirits too find joy and peace; the music reaches its close.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits too rejoice in peace; the music now ends.

translations.literal: Clouds rise and gales lift them; none can hold them back.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds surge and gales lift them—none can hold them back.

translations.literal: Bestowing blessings and granting felicity; how could there be any end!
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing fortune and granting blessing—how could there ever be an end!

sentences.zh: 淳祐祭海神十六首迎神，《延安》宮一曲

translations.literal: Sixteen hymns for the Chunyou sacrifice to the Sea God, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Yan'an》, one palace-mode stanza.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen hymns for the Chunyou sacrifice to the Sea God, welcoming the spirits, to the tune 《Yan'an》, one palace-mode stanza.

translations.literal: Between heaven and earth, the greatest realm is the ocean.
translations.idiomatic: Between heaven and earth, the greatest domain is the sea.

translations.literal: It embraces Qian and enfolds Kun; it spews forth suns and swallows stars.
translations.idiomatic: It wraps heaven and gathers earth, swallowing suns and drowning stars.

translations.literal: The sacrificial canon is newly established; rites and music are clear and bright.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial canon is renewed; rites and music shine clear and bright.

translations.literal: Witness our good reliance on you; come to feast and bring peace.
translations.idiomatic: Look upon our faithful trust in you; come to feast and grant us peace.

sentences.zh: 角一曲四溟廣矣，八紘是紀。

translations.literal: Horn-mode, one stanza: the four seas are vast; the eight directions take their measure from them.
translations.idiomatic: Horn-mode, one stanza: the four seas are vast; the eight directions are measured by them.

translations.literal: Our domain lies in the southeast, winding ten thousand li back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Our realm lies in the southeast, winding ten thousand li to and fro.

translations.literal: Mighty waves and driving winds; on these safety and peril depend.
translations.idiomatic: Great billows and driving winds—on these safety and peril depend.

translations.literal: The sacrifice is especially exalted; may the spirit come down to us!
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice is raised especially high; may the spirit descend to us!

sentences.zh: 徵一曲若稽有唐，克致崇極。

translations.literal: Zhi-mode, one stanza: looking back to the Tang dynasty, able to reach the highest reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi-mode, one stanza: looking back to Tang, able to attain the highest reverence.

translations.literal: The prayer-titles have been raised; thus the sacrificial form is enhanced.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-titles have been raised; thus the sacrificial form is increased.

translations.literal: Joining in suburban sacrifice, the spirit accepts its charge.
translations.idiomatic: Sharing in the suburban sacrifice, the spirit accepts its office.

translations.literal: Our sacrifice begins anew; we earnestly pray for hidden blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Our sacrifice begins anew; we earnestly pray for hidden favor.

sentences.zh: 羽一曲猗與祀禮，四海會同！

translations.literal: Yu-mode, one stanza: how splendid the sacrificial rite—all four seas unite as one!
translations.idiomatic: Yu-mode, one stanza: how splendid the sacrificial rite—all four seas meet as one!

translations.literal: The spirit comes in fullness, lashing thunder and taming wind.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit comes in power, lashing thunder and riding the wind.

translations.literal: Dimly manifest, as if present; those in attendance are solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Faintly manifest, as if present; those in attendance are solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: Protect our multitudes; help us seek divine merit.
translations.idiomatic: Protect our people; help us seek the spirit's blessing.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, to the tune 《Qin'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending and descending, to the tune 《Qin'an》

translations.literal: The spirit has arrived, bestowing blessings in quiet shade.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit has come, bestowing blessings in quiet grace.

translations.literal: The spirit is now seated; regulate these five tones.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit is now seated; set these five tones in order.

translations.literal: Altar and hall are duly solemn; ascending and descending, deeply reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Altar and hall are duly solemn; in ascending and descending, deeply reverent.

translations.literal: The spirit should rest in peace; witness the virtue of our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit rest in peace; look upon the virtue of our hearts.

sentences.zh: 東海位奠玉幣，《德安》百川所歸，天地之左。

translations.literal: Eastern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《De'an》: a hundred rivers converge—the left hand of heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《De'an》: a hundred rivers return here—the left side of heaven and earth.

translations.literal: Vast waters pierce the primordial void; its merit is great in settling low.
translations.idiomatic: Its waters surge through the primordial mist; its merit is great in settling low.

translations.literal: The traveling capital relies upon it; all blessings are borne from it.
translations.idiomatic: The traveling capital relies upon it; all blessings are borne upon it.

translations.literal: Fine silks and precious jade are prepared, to accompany and settle the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Fine silks and precious jade are prepared, to accompany the spirit and complete the rite.

sentences.zh: 南海位奠玉幣，《瀛安》祝融之位，貴乎三神。

translations.literal: Southern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ying'an》: the station of Zhu Rong, honored among the three spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ying'an》: the seat of Zhu Rong, honored among the three spirits.

translations.literal: It swallows and receives the Yangtze and Han; vast and boundless.
translations.idiomatic: It swallows and receives the Yangtze and Han, vast and without limit.

translations.literal: Ever a channel of supply, protecting our people.
translations.idiomatic: Ever a channel of supply, protecting our people.

translations.literal: Reverently we set forth the bright offering; surely witness our humble diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we present the bright offering; surely witness our humble diligence.

sentences.zh: 西海位奠玉幣，《潤安》蒲昌之澤，派引天潢。

translations.literal: Western Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Run'an》: the marshes of Puchang, branching from the celestial waters.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Run'an》: the marshes of Puchang, branching from the celestial river.

translations.literal: Xi and E emerge and withdraw; vast, remote, and dim.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon come and go upon it, vast, remote, and dim.

translations.literal: Though the canopy is high and covers all, borders still lie between.
translations.idiomatic: Though heaven's canopy is high and covers all, borders still lie between.

translations.literal: We contemplate the six directions; may good fortune begin and flourish.
translations.idiomatic: We contemplate the six directions; may good order begin and fortune flourish.

translations.literal: Northern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Han'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Sea station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Han'an》

translations.literal: The vast sea doubly moistens; the earth's registers return to it.
translations.idiomatic: The vast sea moistens again and again; the earth's records return to it.

translations.literal: It receives a hundred streams, bounding the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: It receives a hundred rivers, marking the northern frontier.

translations.literal: Regarding all with equal kindness; my heart is thereby at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Viewing all with equal kindness, my heart is at ease.

translations.literal: We offer fine jade and silks; may the spirit draw near in thought.
translations.idiomatic: We offer fine jade and silks; may the spirit draw near.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》昭格靈貺，祀典肇升。

translations.literal: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: clearly the spirits draw near with blessings; the sacrificial canon is newly raised.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: clearly the spirits draw near with blessings; the sacrificial canon is newly established.

translations.literal: Sacrificial beasts are declared full and ready; carved stands bear them up.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial beasts are declared ready; carved stands bear them up.

translations.literal: Reverently we present offerings; examining our virtue, it is fragrant alone.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we present our offerings; examining our virtue, we find it fragrant.

translations.literal: May the spirits rejoice; the myriad realms are solemn and clear.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits rejoice; the myriad realms are solemn and clear.

sentences.zh: 東海位奠酌獻，《熙安》滄溟之德，東南具依。

translations.literal: Eastern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Xi'an》: the virtue of the blue deep—the southeast wholly relies upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Xi'an》: the virtue of the blue deep—the southeast wholly relies upon it.

translations.literal: Boiling the waves yields salt; the nation's plans depend upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Boiling the waves yields salt; the nation's plans depend upon it.

translations.literal: Stone mortars repel the foe; they aid our royal armies.
translations.idiomatic: Stone mortars repel the enemy; they aid our royal armies.

translations.literal: May the spirit accept and grant blessings, increasing peace and rest.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit accept our offering and grant blessing, increasing peace and rest.

sentences.zh: 南海位酌獻，《貴安》南溟浮天，旁通百蠻。

translations.literal: Southern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Gui'an》: the southern sea floats upon the sky, reaching a hundred barbarian lands roundabout.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Gui'an》: the southern sea floats upon the sky, reaching the hundred barbarian lands roundabout.

translations.literal: Wind-driven masts are swift; treasure ships come and go.
translations.idiomatic: Wind-driven masts are swift; treasure ships come and return.

translations.literal: People and merchants forever rely on it; sitting at ease, brigands and traitors vanish.
translations.idiomatic: People and merchants forever rely on it; at ease, brigands and traitors vanish.

translations.literal: We offer this fine cup; the terrifying waves are stilled.
translations.idiomatic: We offer this fine cup; the terrifying waves are stilled.

translations.literal: Western Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Lei'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Lei'an》

translations.literal: Accumulated streams branch outward, spreading to the shifting sands.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated streams branch outward, spreading to the shifting sands.

translations.literal: Spreading moisture and bestowing bounty; its merit reaches near and far alike.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading moisture and bestowing bounty, its merit reaches near and far alike.

translations.literal: We order the sacrificial canon; all four seas are one family.
translations.idiomatic: We order the sacrificial canon; all four seas are one family.

translations.literal: Reverently we offer fragrant gifts; may the spirits feast in joy!
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we offer fragrant gifts; may the spirits feast in joy!

sentences.zh: 北海位酌獻，《溥安》壝忽會同，裴回安留。

translations.literal: Northern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Pu'an》: suddenly all converge; lingering in peace they rest.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Sea station, libation offering, to the tune 《Pu'an》: suddenly all meet as one; lingering in peace they rest.

translations.literal: Offerings are fat, wine fragrant; the morning rite is duly performed.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are rich, the wine fragrant; the morning rite is duly performed.

translations.literal: Only its virtue is vast; how does it embrace the nine provinces?
translations.idiomatic: How vast is its virtue—how does it embrace the nine provinces?

translations.literal: The imperial command is revered; abundant blessings are sought of ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial command is revered; abundant blessings are sought by our own effort.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《饗安》籩豆有楚，貳觴斯旅。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune 《Xiang'an》: platters and stands are abundant; the double cup makes its circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune 《Xiang'an》: platters and stands are set in abundance; the double cup makes its round.

translations.literal: May the spirits drink their fill; feasting in proper order.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits drink their fill, feasting in proper order.

translations.literal: A hundred spirits, secret and strange, writhing and soaring in dance.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred spirits, secret and strange, writhing and soaring in dance.

translations.literal: Grant us auspicious blessing, lasting forever to the end of time.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us auspicious blessing, lasting forever to the end of time.

sentences.zh: 送神，《成安》告靈饗矣，錫我嘉祚。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: we have announced the feast to the spirits; grant us fine fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Cheng'an》: we have announced the feast to the spirits; grant us fine fortune.

translations.literal: The edges of heaven and earth unfold; gaps open and truth is revealed.
translations.idiomatic: The edges of heaven and earth unfold; the gaps open and truth is revealed.

translations.literal: Dark clouds are gathered up; all the dragons together take flight.
translations.idiomatic: Dark clouds are gathered up; all the dragons together take flight.

translations.literal: Evil and disaster are extinguished; the six directions are clear and serene.
translations.idiomatic: Evil and disaster are extinguished; the six directions are clear and serene.

translations.literal: Twelve hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the Great Fire

sentences.zh: 降神，《高安》圜鍾為宮五緯相天，各率其職。

translations.literal: Descent of the spirit, to the tune 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell: the five planets correspond to heaven, each fulfilling its office.
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the spirit, to the tune 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell: the five planets align with heaven, each fulfilling its office.

translations.literal: Overseeing rites and observation, that one is Mars.
translations.idiomatic: Overseeing rites and observation—that one is Mars.

translations.literal: Essence of supreme yang, arriving at our long summer.
translations.idiomatic: Essence of supreme yang, arriving at our long summer.

translations.literal: By this we seek it; the sacrifice is clear and bright.
translations.idiomatic: By this we seek it; the sacrifice is clear and bright.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾為角有出有藏，伏見靡常。

translations.literal: Jue mode on the yellow bell: there is going forth and there is hiding; appearing and vanishing without fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: Jue mode on the yellow bell: there is going forth and there is hiding; appearing and vanishing without fixed rule.

translations.literal: It aids our state, observing and watching the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: It aids our state, observing and watching the four directions.

translations.literal: Its gaze never swerves from what is right; in the end, truly good.
translations.idiomatic: Its gaze never swerves from what is right; in the end, truly good.

translations.literal: May the spirit come down; bright virtue, fragrant as incense.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit come down; bright virtue, fragrant as incense.

translations.literal: Zhi mode on the great cluster.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi mode on the great cluster

translations.literal: Small and great alike follow the rites, without fault in ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: High and low alike observe the rites, without breach of ritual form.

translations.literal: Displaying colors and arranging duties, the ordered sacrifice is very timely.
translations.idiomatic: Each in proper role and rank, the ordained sacrifice is perfectly timed.

translations.literal: For the reason of this day, review our many ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On this appointed day, let us review our many observances.

translations.literal: Restore those canonical constants; may the spirit come and look upon us!
translations.idiomatic: Restore the ancient canon; may the spirit turn and look upon us!

sentences.zh: 姑洗為羽於赫我宋，以火德王。

translations.literal: Yu mode on the guxian bell: glorious, glorious is our Song, ruling by the virtue of fire.
translations.idiomatic: Yu mode on the guxian bell: radiant is our Song, reigning through the virtue of fire.

translations.literal: Forever and ever the great design; it is the spirit's aid.
translations.idiomatic: Forever shall the great design endure, upheld by the spirit's blessing.

translations.literal: The spirit has come; it is indeed the proper time.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit has come; the hour is exactly right.

translations.literal: Rites prepared, music performed; may the spirit know it.
translations.idiomatic: The rites are complete and the music played; may the spirit perceive our offering.

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Zheng'an》: solemn is his bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: solemn is his bearing.

translations.literal: Pure is his inner heart.
translations.idiomatic: Pure is the heart within.

translations.literal: Towering, towering is the lofty altar; through it one communicates with the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Loftily rises the sacred altar; through it we commune with the spirit.

translations.literal: The spirit deigns to descend; how fine is the spirit's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit deigns to descend; blessed is the spirit's favor.

translations.literal: Reverently bowing, descending and ascending; O spirit, abide in peace.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent bowing we descend and ascend; spirit, rest here in peace.

sentences.zh: 熒惑位奠玉幣，《嘉安》馨香接神，蚃恍惚。

translations.literal: Mars station, presenting jade and silks, 《Ga'an》: fragrant incense receives the spirit, dim and indistinct.
