translations.idiomatic: Mars station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ga'an》: fragrant incense welcomes the spirit, vague and luminous.

translations.literal: Seek the spirit through sincerity; present sincerity through offerings.
translations.idiomatic: We seek the spirit with sincerity and offer sincerity through these gifts.

translations.literal: There is this jade on its mat; there is this basket of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Here is jade on its silken mat, here silks in their basket.

translations.literal: Therefore we present and set them forth, making clear this refined intent.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we lay them out in offering, declaring our pure intent.

sentences.zh: 商丘宣明王位奠幣，《嘉安》

translations.literal: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation station, presenting silks, 《Ga'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation station, presenting silks, to the tune 《Ga'an》

translations.literal: Mars is in heaven; only fire combines with it.
translations.idiomatic: Mars shines in heaven; of all the elements, fire alone aligns with it.

translations.literal: This spirit presides over fire, pure and one, without admixture.
translations.idiomatic: This spirit governs fire—singular, pure, unmixed.

translations.literal: Made partner to Mars; in sacrificial merit, just so.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed as Mars's companion—such is the merit of this sacrifice.

translations.literal: These unworthy silks, thereby to declare our reverence.
translations.idiomatic: These humble silks we offer to declare our devotion.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》火遵其令，無物不長。

translations.literal: Presenting the offering stand, 《Feng'an》: fire follows its command; nothing fails to grow.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: fire fulfills its mandate, and nothing fails to flourish.

translations.literal: Look upon these sacrificial beasts; we strive to have them properly reared.
translations.idiomatic: See these victims raised for the altar—each one properly nurtured.

translations.literal: Fattened to sacrifice to the spirit, plump and rich.
translations.idiomatic: Raised for the spirit's table, sleek and fat.

translations.literal: If not fit for the spirit, where else would they go?
translations.idiomatic: If not offered to the spirit, to whom would they belong?

sentences.zh: 熒惑位酌獻，《祐安》皇念有神，介我戩穀。

translations.literal: Mars station, libation offering, 《You'an》: the sovereign remembers there is a spirit, blessing us with abundant grain.
translations.idiomatic: Mars station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》: the sovereign recalls the spirit and blesses us with overflowing harvest.

translations.literal: At this season of glorious prosperity, we have this fine bounty.
translations.idiomatic: In this radiant and prosperous season, we enjoy this noble abundance.

translations.literal: As we pour and offer it, there is its savory fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: We pour and present it, and savory fragrance rises.

translations.literal: O spirit, you feast at ease; be intoxicated with this fine cup.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, feast at ease and savor this noble libation.

sentences.zh: 宣明王位酌獻，《祐安》誰其祀神？

translations.literal: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, 《You'an》: who is it that sacrifices to the spirit?
translations.idiomatic: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》: who is it that makes this sacrifice to the spirit?

translations.literal: Knowing the spirit's preferences.
translations.idiomatic: One who knows what the spirit desires.

translations.literal: E Bo sacrificed to fire, toiling for the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: E Bo served fire in sacrifice, laboring on the spirit's behalf.

translations.literal: Earnestly appointed as accompanying sacrifice, already joined with fire.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen as companion at the feast, united with fire ever since.

translations.literal: With this delicious wine, we receive the spirit's fine blessing.
translations.idiomatic: With this rich and joyous wine, we welcome the spirit's gracious favor.

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Wen'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune 《Wen'an》

translations.literal: The spirit having bestowed its gifts, delights in our food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit has granted its bounty and savors our feast.

translations.literal: Extended through repeated offerings, to receive spiritual abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Again and again we offer, receiving the spirit's overflowing grace.

sentences.zh: 神方常羊，鹹畢我觴，於再於三，於誠之將。

translations.literal: The spirit now roams at ease; all complete my cup; a second time, a third; in sincerity we present.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit wanders at ease; let every cup be filled—twice and thrice we pour in utmost sincerity.

sentences.zh: 送神用《理安》登降上下，奠璧獻斝。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, using 《Li'an》: ascending and descending, above and below; setting forth the bi and presenting the jue-cup.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Li'an》: ascending and descending on every side, we set out the bi and present the libation cup.

translations.literal: Music escorts them, murmuring softly; in the rites, nothing is violated.
translations.idiomatic: Soft music sees them on their way; not one step of the ritual falls out of form.

translations.literal: The night vigil has reached the dawn; the spirit is about to return.
translations.idiomatic: Night watch has passed into dawn; the spirit prepares to depart.

translations.literal: Look upon our state and clan; leave us abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Turn and regard our realm; leave us blessings beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 出火祀大辰十二首降神，《高安》圜鍾為宮

translations.literal: Twelve hymns for the Exit-Fire sacrifice to the Great Constellation: descent of the spirit, 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve hymns for the Exit-Fire sacrifice to the Great Constellation—descent of the spirit, to the tune 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell

translations.literal: Radiant, radiant is our Song; the fire virtue is what bestows it.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and radiant is our Song, endowed with the virtue of fire.

translations.literal: Using fire to mark the seasons, truly by images and categories.
translations.idiomatic: Fire marks the seasons—a fitting emblem of their kinds.

translations.literal: The spirit by kind rejoices; sincerity through kind arrives.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit delights in what matches its kind; sincerity comes through likeness.

translations.literal: When moved, then it connects; it responds to our yang fire-drill mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Moved, it links with us—answering to our sun fire-starter.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾為角樂音上達，粵惟出虛。

translations.literal: Jue mode on the yellow bell: music sounds reach upward; only then does it emerge from the void.
translations.idiomatic: Jue mode on the yellow bell: music rises on high, issuing forth from emptiness itself.

translations.literal: Fire's nature is to blaze upward; yet it also arises from nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Fire's nature is to blaze upward, yet it is born from nothingness.

translations.literal: Our bells and our stone chimes, our sheng pipes and our yu pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Our bells and stone chimes, our sheng and yu.

translations.literal: Qi alike, sounds responding; glorious is the matching of signs!
translations.idiomatic: Breath and tone in harmony—bright is the accord of signs!

sentences.zh: 太簇為徵火在六氣，獨處其兩。

translations.literal: Zhi mode on the great cluster: fire among the six qi occupies two positions alone.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi mode on the great cluster: among the six seasonal breaths, fire holds two phases alone.

translations.literal: The spirit of quickening life is the lord; the constellations can aid.
translations.idiomatic: The lord of engendering life—constellations assist at every turn.

translations.literal: How shall we verify this?
translations.idiomatic: How may this be verified?

translations.literal: Observe these signs hung above.
translations.idiomatic: Read the signs cast across the sky.

translations.literal: Soaring in the carriage of the blue dragon, coming to feast.
translations.idiomatic: Mounted on the azure dragon, he comes to feast.

sentences.zh: 姑洗為羽星入於戌，與火俱詘。

translations.literal: Yu mode on the guxian bell: the star enters into xu, together with fire both withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Yu mode on the guxian bell: the star enters the Dog sign and withdraws together with fire.

translations.literal: Fire emerges from chen, and together with the star both extend.
translations.idiomatic: From the Dragon sign fire emerges, and star and flame advance together.

translations.literal: One extension, one withdrawal—who controls them?
translations.idiomatic: Advancing and retreating in turn—who holds the reins?

translations.literal: Useful for going out and coming in; the people all use them.
translations.idiomatic: Beneficial in their comings and goings—all the people rely on them.

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Zheng'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, to the tune 《Zheng'an》

translations.literal: Towering is that fine altar; the Red Hidden first arrives.
translations.idiomatic: Loftily stands the sacred altar, as the Red Omen first makes its entry.

translations.literal: Spreading light and shining brilliance, vast and vast as if present.
translations.idiomatic: Radiance spreads and gleams; vast, as though the spirit stood before us.

translations.literal: Bowing and looking up, repeating the 《Li》 movement; silently joining with the essence.
translations.idiomatic: Bow and rise in the 《Li》 ritual dance, silently meeting the numinous essence.

translations.literal: Follow me descending and ascending; solemnly hear the jade pendants.
translations.idiomatic: Follow in my ascent and descent, and listen solemnly to the jade at our belts.

sentences.zh: 大辰位奠玉幣，《嘉安》維莫之春，五陽發舒。

translations.literal: Great Constellation station, presenting jade and silks, 《Ga'an》: it is the spring at year's end; the five yangs unfold.
translations.idiomatic: Great Constellation station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Ga'an》: late in spring, the five yang forces unfold.

translations.literal: The sun has set; the Three Stars are in the corner.
translations.idiomatic: The sun has set, and the Three Stars stand in the corner of the sky.

translations.literal: No gift exceeds silks; no gem surpasses jade.
translations.idiomatic: No offering is more suited than silks, no gift more fine than jade.

translations.literal: The bright offering is very timely; divine light looks down.
translations.idiomatic: The bright offering comes at the right hour; divine radiance gazes down.

sentences.zh: 商丘宣明王奠幣，《嘉安》二七儲神，與天地並。

translations.literal: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation, presenting silks, 《Ga'an》: the twenty-seven stored spirits, alongside Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation, presenting silks, to the tune 《Ga'an》: the twenty-seven stellar spirits rank with Heaven and Earth.

translations.literal: Who can match his virtue?
translations.idiomatic: Who may compare in virtue?

translations.literal: Only the Director of the South.
translations.idiomatic: None but the Director of the South.

translations.literal: Achievements abundant as Yao of Tang; blessings flow to the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: Merit vast as Tang Yao's; grace flows to the myriad people.

translations.literal: Made partner in the solemn sacrifice; in the array of offerings, fitly placed.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed companion at the solemn rite, with offerings arrayed as befits his rank.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》有嚴在滌，陳彼牲牢。

translations.literal: Presenting the offering stand, 《Feng'an》: there is solemn purification at the wash; those sacrificial beasts are set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the offering stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: solemn cleansing at the wash-trough; the victims stand ready.

translations.literal: Great and rich is the stand; we present this blood and hair.
translations.idiomatic: Rich and generous the offering stand; we present blood and hide.

translations.literal: From the first birth of the people, eating raw flesh was just so.
translations.idiomatic: Since humankind first arose, raw fare was their way.

translations.literal: By roasting and by broiling—who was it that first did so?
translations.idiomatic: Roasting and grilling—who first taught us how?

translations.literal: Great Constellation station, libation offering, 《You'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Great Constellation station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》

translations.literal: What is the Great Constellation?
translations.idiomatic: What is the Great Constellation?

translations.literal: In the north there is the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the north stands the Dipper.

translations.literal: It was once the broom star; that name is very apt.
translations.idiomatic: Once it was called the Comet Star—a name most fitting.

translations.literal: In hidden glory repaying merit; purified offerings—who dares lag behind?
translations.idiomatic: In quiet honor we repay its service; with purified rites we hasten to offer.

translations.literal: At ease with the fine cup, thus savor the delicious wine.
translations.idiomatic: At leisure with the noble libation, we savor this rich wine.

sentences.zh: 宣明王位酌獻，《祐安》周設司爟，雖列夏官。

translations.literal: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, 《You'an》: Zhou established the Director of Fire, though ranked under the Minister of Summer.
translations.idiomatic: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》: the Zhou created the Director of Fire, listing the office under the Minister of Summer.

translations.literal: Still following the ample Zhou rites; to open the rite's beginning is truly hard.
translations.idiomatic: We still follow the great Zhou rites, yet to establish this rite anew is no easy task.

translations.literal: Behold that hill of Shang; forever cherish the first making.
translations.idiomatic: Look upon that mound of Shang, and ever honor how fire was first brought forth.

translations.literal: These unworthy cassia and pepper; not offered as repayment.
translations.idiomatic: These humble cassia and pepper—we do not offer them as repayment.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》潛之伏矣，柞槱既休。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Wen'an》: it has hidden and lain concealed; the oak faggots are already at rest.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary and final offerings, to the tune 《Wen'an》: fire has sunk and hidden away; the oak faggots for kindling lie still.

translations.literal: Beginning to come forth, elm and willow are sought.
translations.idiomatic: Once again it stirs toward us, and elm and willow are gathered.

translations.literal: The spirit carriage, feathers scattering; still let it abide in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit carriages trail their plumes—may the spirit yet linger here in peace.

translations.literal: Drink our three cups; speech flowing softly.
translations.idiomatic: Accept these three libations, gracious and warm in every word.

sentences.zh: 送神，《理安》五運惟火，寔宗眾陽。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, 《Li'an》: of the five cycles, fire alone is lord of the many yangs.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Li'an》: of the Five Phases, fire is chief among all yang forces.

translations.literal: The lodge waxes strong and is employed for brightness; through a thousand years ever more radiant.
translations.idiomatic: Its station grows vigorous and sheds light—through a thousand years brighter still.

translations.literal: The spirit guardian now returns; peacefully dwells in the fire chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit guardian takes its leave, settling calmly in the House of Fire.

translations.literal: May disastrous fire not arise; the fiery dynasty be forever prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Let no calamitous blaze arise; may the fiery realm endure forever.

translations.literal: Twelve hymns for the Return-Fire sacrifice to the Great Constellation.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve hymns for the Return-Fire sacrifice to the Great Constellation

sentences.zh: 降神，《高安》圜鍾為宮赫赫皇圖，炎炎火德。

translations.literal: Descent of the spirit, 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell: glorious, glorious is the imperial design; blazing, blazing is the fire virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the spirit, to the tune 《Gao'an》, gong mode on the round bell: resplendent the imperial design, blazing the virtue of fire.

translations.literal: Extending the spirits' gifts, encompassing the regional states.
translations.idiomatic: Extending the spirits' gifts, embracing every realm.

translations.literal: Grain offerings are already abundant; stands and vessels have fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings overflow; stands and vessels breathe fragrance.

translations.literal: For ten thousand such years, responsive sacrifice without end.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years, our answering sacrifice shall never cease.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾為角火星之躔，有燁其光。

translations.literal: Yellow Bell as jue mode: Mars's celestial station has a blazing radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Bell in the jue mode: Mars's station blazes with light.

translations.literal: It is marked in the chen position; it lies hidden in the xu quarter.
translations.idiomatic: It stands forth in the chen position and hides in the xu quarter.

translations.literal: Seasons are harmonious and years are full; benevolence appears and is stored away.
translations.idiomatic: Seasons are mild and harvests full; benevolence shows itself, then is laid away.

translations.literal: We announce to you, myriad people: going forth and taking in have their constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: We tell you, all the people: going out and coming in follow a constant law.

translations.literal: Grand Cluster as zhi mode.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Cluster in the zhi mode

translations.literal: The month of late autumn—within the pitch-pipes, Wushe.
translations.idiomatic: In the month of late autumn, the pitch-pipes reach Wushe.

translations.literal: Agricultural work is fully gathered; the fire work announces completion.
translations.idiomatic: The harvest is complete; the work of fire is finished.

translations.literal: Able to offer pure sacrifice, able to worship—there is solemnity, there is support.
translations.idiomatic: We offer pure sacrifice and worship—with solemn care and reverent aid.

translations.literal: Wind-horses and cloud-chariots—may they still come and arrive!
translations.idiomatic: Wind-horses and cloud-chariots—may they yet come to us!

sentences.zh: 姑洗為羽明明我後，重祭欽祠。

translations.literal: Guxian Wash as yu mode: bright, bright is our sovereign; the weighty sacrifice is reverently offered.
translations.idiomatic: Guxian Wash in the yu mode: bright is our sovereign; the great sacrifice is reverently performed.

translations.literal: The officials conduct the rite with solemnity; thereby presenting the morning ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The officials perform the rite in solemn order and present the morning ceremony.

translations.literal: Rites only according to their measure; things only according to their season.
translations.idiomatic: The rites match their measure; the offerings match their season.

translations.literal: May the spirits listen; fortune and emolument come thereby.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits hear; blessing and rank draw near.

sentences.zh: 升殿，《正安》猗與明壇，右平左墄！

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Zheng'an》: how splendid is the bright altar—level on the right, stepped on the left!
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, to the tune 《Zheng'an》: how splendid the bright altar, level on the right and stepped on the left!

translations.literal: Court robes are thereby resplendent; jade pendants have their measure.
translations.idiomatic: Court robes shine forth; jade pendants keep their rhythm.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending are only at the proper hour—neither slow nor swift.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent come only at the proper hour—neither slow nor hasty.

translations.literal: Thereby exalting the great sacrifice; ritual texts are all in order.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we exalt the great sacrifice; every detail of ritual stands in order.

sentences.zh: 大辰位奠玉幣，《嘉安》金行序晚，玉露晨清。

translations.literal: Great Constellation station, presenting jade and silks, 《Jia'an》: the Metal phase orders late season; jade dew at dawn is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Great Constellation station, presenting jade and silks, to the tune 《Jia'an》: Metal's season draws late; jade dew at dawn is clear.

translations.literal: Fasting and ablution, abundant and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Fasting and purification, rich and pure.

translations.literal: Solemn and reverent toward the spirits and gods.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and reverent before the spirits.

translations.literal: Fine silks only in due measure; fine jade only in purity.
translations.idiomatic: Fine silks in due measure; fine jade in perfect purity.

translations.literal: Thereby we present them; we may hope they come and listen.
translations.idiomatic: We present them here, hoping they will come and heed.

sentences.zh: 商丘宣明王位奠幣，《嘉安》

translations.literal: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation station, presenting silks, 《Jia'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Shangqiu Lord of Bright Manifestation station, presenting silks, to the tune 《Jia'an》

translations.literal: Reverently considering the Director of Fire—from the House of Taotang.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently recall the Director of Fire, from the age of Taotang.

translations.literal: Enfeoffed at Shangqiu, sharing sacrifice in the constellation rites.
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffed at Shangqiu, he shares the constellation sacrifice.

translations.literal: He has merit among the people; he has virtue in his position.
translations.idiomatic: His merit rests with the people; his virtue rests in his office.

translations.literal: We dare not replace the canonical constant.
translations.idiomatic: We dare not alter the ancient canon.

translations.literal: Only reverently presenting the silks.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently present these silks alone.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》萬彙攸成，四方寧謐。

translations.literal: Raising the stand, 《Feng'an》: the myriad categories are thereby complete; the four quarters are tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Raising the stand, to the tune 《Feng'an》: all things are brought to completion; the four quarters are at peace.

translations.literal: The ritual officer sends forth announcement; broadly preserving the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer proclaims; may the people's strength be preserved everywhere.

translations.literal: Thereupon presenting this victim.
translations.idiomatic: We present this victim.

translations.literal: For the stand it is greatly ample.
translations.idiomatic: For the stand it is abundantly full.

translations.literal: May abundant blessing be granted; thereby harmonizing the people's norms.
translations.idiomatic: Grant abundant blessing and harmonize the people's ways.

sentences.zh: 大辰位酌獻，《祐安》庶功備矣，休德昭明。

translations.literal: Great Constellation station, libation offering, 《You'an》: the myriad works are complete; excellent virtue is bright and manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Great Constellation station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》: every task is complete; noble virtue shines clear.

translations.literal: Heaven and earth brew harmony; the fragrant ale is thereby clear.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth blend in harmony; the fragrant ale runs clear.

translations.literal: With jade libation cup we pour; jasper goblets are filled to the brim.
translations.idiomatic: We pour with the jade libation cup; jasper goblets brim full.

translations.literal: Roaming round and round, they come to feast and come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: They roam and circle, coming to feast and to abide in peace.

sentences.zh: 宣明王位酌獻，《祐安》廣大建祀，式崇其配。

translations.literal: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, 《You'an》: broadly establishing sacrifice; thereby exalting his consort.
translations.idiomatic: Lord of Bright Manifestation station, libation offering, to the tune 《You'an》: we broadly raise the sacrifice and exalt his consort.

translations.literal: Fragrance is here; clear wine is already borne.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrance is here; clear wine is already raised.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn in radiance; vast, vast as if present.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn in the light, vast as though truly here.

translations.literal: Thereby cherishing fine celebration—it is the spirits' gift.
translations.idiomatic: We cherish this fine joy—it is the spirits' gift.

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, 《Wen'an》.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, to the tune 《Wen'an》

translations.literal: Silks and jade are solemnly set forth; pipes and reeds are all raised.
translations.idiomatic: Silks and jade are laid out in solemn array; pipes and reeds sound together.

translations.literal: Osmanthus ale floats in the cups.
translations.idiomatic: Osmanthus ale brims in the cups.

translations.literal: Jade delicacies overflow the stands.
translations.idiomatic: Fine delicacies overflow the stands.

translations.literal: In the rites there are three presentations; harmonious and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: The rite has three offerings, harmonious and in order.

translations.literal: The spirits are fully drunk and halt; celebration flows through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are fully drunk and at rest; celebration flows through the world.

sentences.zh: 送神，《理安》神靈降鑒，天地回旋。

translations.literal: Escorting the spirits, 《Li'an》: the spirits descend in scrutiny; heaven and earth wheel round.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits, to the tune 《Li'an》: the spirits descend and gaze; heaven and earth wheel about.

translations.literal: Only fragrance is presented; already drunk, they delight therein.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrance alone is offered; drunk already, they delight in it.

translations.literal: The various stewards thereupon withdraw; the rites are without lapse.
translations.idiomatic: The stewards withdraw; not one detail of the rite is missed.

translations.literal: Heaped blessing descends, auspice comes down; may the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing heaps high, auspice descends—may the Son of Heaven live ten thousand years.
